original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system survives ten abrupt AC removals after five minutes of CPU/DIMM/storage stress at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, records expected loss events and restores all data/devices/services.
original_method: Freeze full device and safe storage-target identity; define workload and five-minute steady state; use dry-chamber/dew-point control and a rated interlocked AC fixture with exact drop/reapply dwell and auto-power policy; perform ten supervised drops at measured +5% rails; after each cycle capture readiness, expected power-loss events, storage integrity and complete inventory; abort on fault, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator establishes cold/high-rail full load, triggers ten physical drops, observes recovery and performs safe warm-up.
required_inputs: Full device serial/slot inventory and safe storage targets
Stress tools/profiles and five-minute load floors/steady-state rule
AC fixture/feed rating, drop/reapply dwell and auto-power policy
Expected power-loss events and readiness limits
Data-integrity/device-loss/error thresholds, OOB abort and recovery
safety_requirements: Use interlocked mains equipment rated for load/inrush
Protect boot and non-disposable storage from undefined writes
Maintain independent OOB and preserve logs
Never silently retry; abort on electrical/data/device/moisture/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: May analyze per-drop workload, inventory, integrity and event evidence
Must not choose targets, interrupt AC, control chamber/rails or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve load/targets, fixture timing, cold profile and event policy

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a ten-entry fault ledger linking load state, fixture transition, expected events, data integrity, inventory and dew-point/rail data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe target identity, steady-state proof, controlled fault timing, condensation protection and per-cycle integrity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Graceful cycles or unloaded drops cannot substitute for abrupt loss during active storage and compute work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Expected AC-loss logs must be distinguished from unexpected device/data failures, and cold chamber handling introduces a separate condensation hazard.

review_improvement: Preserves abrupt loaded-loss coverage while adding target safety, per-drop data integrity and cold-environment protections.
independent_technical_reasoning: The critical state is active storage I/O and high load at the instant of power loss. A recovered OS does not prove storage integrity or complete enumeration, and moisture during cold transitions is an independent hazard. Each event needs synchronized load, power, data and environmental evidence.
